name: Impulse Response Estimation Benchmark
description: Provides standardized evaluation and extended results for acoustic impulse response estimation methods.
evaluation_method: error-based (MSE/NMSE), signal-reconstruction metrics (SDR), and distance measures (e.g., log-spectral distance)
reputation: Moderately known within the acoustic signal‑processing community as a standard reference for impulse response estimation; limited adoption outside that specialty.
notes: Audio-specific, non-LLM benchmark; performance is highly sensitive to SNR, microphone/setup and dataset specifics; datasets can be small or domain-specific, so results may not generalize broadly.
